hook_text: Three stations, one term. Can you explain them all before the bell rings?
clip_script: Water Week in Mbombela. Station one: ice, water, steam. Packed, sliding, spread out. Then sort, sieve, settle, decant and filter a mixture. Station two: sugar dissolves into a clear solution. Solute, solvent, saturated, and hot water makes it faster! Station three: brown river water. Plastic, fertiliser and germs. Wetlands help, filters clean, boiling kills the germs. Term 2, done!
visual_style: Whiteboard school hall with three exhibition tables, each with its key objects and a one-word label.
mood: Proud and confident, like presenting to parents.
pacing: Three quick stations, one big idea at each.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and explain one station to someone at home.
